title: File:Bilingual Wall Map of Thailand c1958 Shell.jpg
author: Shell (Shell Company of Thailand, Ltd.). Printed by George Philip and Son.
description: A large bilingual wall map of Thailand, circa 1958 (undated). It features infrastructure (highways, railways), cities, towns, topographic detail. A compass with the shell logo is above the map title. Size: 177.8 x 99.06 cm. Scale: 1:1000000.
